caption: The drawing depicts a wooden roll-top desk, shown from an angle that displays its front and right side. The desk is primarily composed of brown wood with a varnished finish that gives it a slightly glossy appearance. It stands on four slender, tapered legs with decorative bands near the top of each leg. The upper section of the desk contains two horizontal drawers, each with a small round knob. Beneath these drawers is the roll-top section, which is open to reveal a series of vertical pigeonholes and one narrow horizontal drawer, also with a knob. The central writing surface is pulled out and extends forward, supported at the sides. Below the writing surface are additional drawers and a cabinet compartment, all featuring round knobs matching those on the upper drawers. The background is a plain, light color with slight blotches and no additional objects or elements present.
title: Roll-Top Desk
